brand.label: Who we are
brand.p: Azur Home Collection is not a real estate agency. It is a luxury hospitality company — conceived like a five-star hotel, applied to private villas. Each property is selected, managed and rented to international hotel standards.

val.discret_p: A relationship of trust with our property owners.
val.surmesure_p: Every villa, every stay conceived individually.

sv.gestion_p: Year-round villa care: maintenance, gardens, pools, permanent housekeeping.

sv.conc_p: Premium on-demand services: private chef, transfers, bespoke experiences.

aqserena.desc: Nestled in the heights of Canebiers, this architect-designed villa offers breathtaking views over the Bay of Saint-Tropez. Its infinity pool seems to merge with the Mediterranean at sunset.

bastide.desc: An exceptional 2-hectare estate in Ramatuelle, between pine forest and vineyards. Bastide des Pins embodies the most secretive Provence, minutes from the village of Saint-Tropez.

emeraude.desc: The pinnacle of Alpine luxury at Courchevel 1850. This exceptional chalet benefits from direct ski-in ski-out access and a 200m² spa for stays of absolute elegance.

boreal.desc: Perched in the heart of Courchevel 1850, Chalet Boréal combines authentic mountain architecture with five-star amenities. Ski-in ski-out, prestige wine cellar and dedicated concierge service.

cx.label: Concierge
cx.p: From arrival to the starred restaurant, from the private spa to a sunset yacht — our team orchestrates every moment with five-star hotel precision.

ow.label: Property owners
ow.p: Our team, trained to hotel excellence, fully manages and markets your property. Optimised revenue. Absolute discretion.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What does renting a villa in Saint-Tropez include?
faq.a1: Each of our villas includes daily housekeeping, premium hotel linen and access to our personalised concierge 24/7. Most feature private pools, panoramic terraces and premium equipment.
faq.q2: When is the best time to book in Courchevel?
faq.a2: We recommend booking between September and November. Christmas and February school holiday slots are most in demand. Join our private list for early access.
faq.q3: Do your services cover both destinations?
faq.a3: Yes. Our concierge operates in Saint-Tropez and Courchevel with the same standards year-round.
faq.a4: Absolutely. Every stay is tailored: daily housekeeping, private chef, spa treatments, helicopter transfers, floral arrangements on arrival.
faq.a5: Comprehensive management: premium marketing, hotel-standard welcome, maintenance and monthly reporting. +32% in rental revenue on average.
faq.a6: Flexible conditions tailored to each property. A dedicated advisor presents the exact terms at your request.
faq.cta_sub: Our advisors design your bespoke stay.
